title: Uniform approximation of continuous compactly supported covector fields by test forms supported in an open set (selected proof, step 3)
statement: Let P, n, d ∈ ℕ and let c : Λ := Covector (Euclid P) n → ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be a continuous linear equivalence with covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖ for every α ∈ Λ. Let V ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let G : ℝ^P → Λ be continuous with compact support and tsupport G ⊆ V, and let ε > 0. Then there is an n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λ that is C^∞ with compact support (IsTestForm ω), with tsupport ω ⊆ V and covectorEuclideanNorm (ω(x) − G(x)) ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖) → IsOpen V → Continuous G → HasCompactSupport G → tsupport G ⊆ V → 0 < ε → ∃ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ V ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - G x) ≤ ε
